business: Apartment renovation marketplace in Tbilisi (working name: not chosen)
target: Private owners of a flat in Tbilisi who plan a full or large renovation, own-use or rental

behaviours.name: Has a crew in mind
behaviours.how: Knows a crew through friends and only wants the paperwork handled.

behaviours.name: Gets three quotes
behaviours.how: Compares several quotes and decides on price.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: A past renovation ran over budget or stalled.

behaviours.name: Reads reviews
behaviours.how: Checks reviews and social pages before contacting anyone.

behaviours.name: Hands-off
behaviours.how: Wants one point of contact and does not want to chase crews.

objections: Xfix and Homico are free and already here; why would I pay you?
Who checks that the crew is any good?
Why not just pay the crew directly and skip the middleman?
Can the crew run over budget and I have no recourse?
I can get three quotes myself in a week
Will the crew in Tbilisi actually bid on a standard brief?
habits: you have a flat in Tbilisi that needs a full refit
you have used a crew from a friend and it was late
you check a Facebook page before calling anyone
you read the reviews in Russian or Georgian
